text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two months' rest for fish stocks proves insufficient as resources are dwindling.
- Verdict in appeal of French couple sentenced for up to four years imprisonment due on Sept 9.
- Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui expected for a three-day visit on Wednesday.
- Two French women arrested in Tangier on drug charges.
- More than 100 Spanish vessels withdraw from Moroccan waters to allow fish to recover.
- Education is not on political agenda despite serious crisis.
- Morocco calls on the United States and Iraq to avoid escalation of the crisis in northern Iraq following the U.S. missile attack.
